head: Senti private journal app for iPhone keeps entries on your phone
dek: Senti is a new journal for iPhone and iPad where you type, speak or add photos, with no account, no ads and no subscription. It was #78 among paid Lifestyle apps on the US App Store on 18 November.
details: It costs $4.99 once until 25 November, then $9.99, made by Marcellot Digital Marketing LLC. Entries are encrypted on the device, the app locks with Face ID, Touch ID or a PIN, and a separate vault has its own PIN. Voice typing, search by meaning and mood analysis run on the phone; iCloud sync is optional and off by default. It adds a daily question, letters to your future self and exports to PDF, text or JSON; an optional Claude plug-in works only with your own API key.
where: iPhone and iPad (iOS 26 or later), App Store
means: If you want a diary that doesn't send your writing anywhere and doesn't charge monthly, this is a one-time purchase.
todo: Look it up on the App Store; the $4.99 price is listed until 25 November.
thumb_words: SENTI: A JOURNAL THAT STAYS PRIVATE
